mode_definitions.baseline: Fixed static detector thresholds and a static baseline deception strategy; paired seeded reaction rules are simulated for comparison.
mode_definitions.adaptive: Existing synthetic profile classifier and recommendation policy select a local strategy and simulation-only detector thresholds; the same seeded reaction model measures synthetic engagement. No live configuration is changed.
mode_definitions.closed_loop: A deterministic, experiment-local contextual strategy policy selects from a bounded synthetic library, simulates a seeded attacker reaction, measures the resulting events, and updates bounded reward estimates. No live configuration is changed.

comparison.note: Differences are adaptive minus baseline. When selected, closed_loop shows its measured aggregate separately. Percentage changes are omitted when the baseline is zero or unavailable; no confidence interval is claimed.

metric_definitions.detection_coverage: Detector true positives divided by ground-truth suspicious synthetic events.
metric_definitions.event_capture_rate: Events processed locally divided by generated events; no network transport is involved.
metric_definitions.incident_detection_rate: Suspicious scenarios with at least one detector alert divided by suspicious scenarios.
metric_definitions.detection_latency_median_seconds: Median virtual event time from scenario start to first detector alert, among detected scenarios.
metric_definitions.false_positive_rate: Benign synthetic events flagged divided by all benign synthetic events.
metric_definitions.false_negative_rate: Suspicious synthetic events not flagged divided by all suspicious synthetic events.
metric_definitions.scenario_completion_rate: Completed scenario-mode repetitions divided by requested scenario-mode repetitions.
metric_definitions.adaptation_frequency: Adaptive runs with a selected non-neutral policy divided by adaptive runs.
metric_definitions.adaptation_effectiveness: Adaptive minus baseline detection coverage in percentage points; only when both modes are included.
metric_definitions.average_event_processing_ms: Measured event-loop wall time divided by events processed; includes per-event local incident correlation, excludes model training, scenario generation/classification, temporary incident-store setup, and experiment-result persistence.
metric_definitions.execution_time_seconds: Observed wall time for the experiment request; machine-dependent.
metric_definitions.peak_memory_bytes: Unavailable: process memory is not measured by this harness.
metric_definitions.simulated_engagement_rate: Completed synthetic runs with a simulated non-abandon reaction divided by completed runs; based on explicit seeded reaction probabilities, not observed attackers.
metric_definitions.mean_synthetic_interaction_depth: Mean generated synthetic event count plus any simulated follow-up events per completed run; not a real session depth.
metric_definitions.median_synthetic_session_duration_second: Median virtual time between the first and last generated event, including simulated follow-up timestamps; no wall-clock attacker dwell is observed.
metric_definitions.unique_decoys_accessed: Unavailable: synthetic events do not identify actual decoy assets accessed.

limitations: All events and labels are synthetic; results do not establish real-world detection or prevention effectiveness.
The model classifier is trained on the existing deterministic synthetic dataset; category output is not evidence of attacker intent.
Adaptation changes only the experiment-local detector thresholds and records the selected strategy; no live policy, decoy registry, event store, or ledger is mutated.
Event capture measures local processing only. Network delivery, sensor loss, authentication, and incident-store behavior are outside this harness.
Confidence intervals and process memory are unavailable; repetitions are bounded and are not treated as a statistical sample by default.
evaluation_scope: Seeded synthetic scenarios only; not operational detection or defense effectiveness.
